steps.content: The Butcher moves like a relentless warrior, continuously "clearing out" those he thinks may be the Witch. You manage to prevent some killings, but for the most part, you can only watch the victims turn to wax and vanish before your eyes.
As the most perilous hour around midnight passes, the town finally grows quiet. He returns to the shed behind his butcher shop.
You scan your surroundings, surprised that a player could have such an established identity within the story, even possessing their own "base."

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: Whether it's here or there... why are there always people interfering with others' work...

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: I was working so hard, barely getting any sleep every night, and yet my boss said he was going to fire me...

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: No, I can't make any mistakes this time. I've worked so hard to secure this position... I have to do my job properly... I just need to kill the Witch, and everything will be fine...

In the pitch-dark shed, lit only by a single candelabra and faint moonlight, the Butcher sits dejectedly by the window. He pulls the glimmering name tag from his pocket, cradling it in his hands like a prize, stroking it over and over.

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: I've killed so many... but the calamity hasn't stopped... No, none of them was her... What am I supposed to do now...

His name tag is glowing much more brightly than when he first received it, like a precious prize. In contrast, yours remains unchanged, still just a metal plate inscribed with the word "Voyager" and your goal.
You sense that his transformation is inextricably linked to that name tag. The Butcher tucks it away and begins to slowly sharpen his ax.

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: The ax just isn't sharp enough yet. That's it. The ax will tell me... It will show me the real Witch...

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: Next time, I will not fail.
Whatever his original intentions might have been, the indiscriminate murders won't help you get out of here. It only risks causing chaos. You also won't gain any useful intelligence.
It's time to get out of here.
Just as you carefully edge toward the door, the Butcher suddenly whips his head around, fixing you with a wide, chilling grin!

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: Testing them one by one takes too long. Want to... join me?
The Butcher moves closer to you, his voice dropping to a lower, more broken whisper.

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: Those glowing spikes of yours... can they kill the Witch? Show me again.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...I don't know what you're talking about. That ability can't help you identify the Witch.

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: You don't get it?
You're about to keep denying it when the words die in your throat. The Butcher raises his ax, his lips splitting into a bone-chilling grin.

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: Do you get it now?
